title: Norwegian Fish Fry
description: A delicate and flavorful fish dish inspired by Indian cuisine, using Norwegian fish and a crispy flaky crust.
instructions: Rinse the fish fillets under cold water and pat them dry.
Mix together the salty flaky norwegian fish seasoning, baking soda, and lemon juice to make a marinade.
Coat the fish fillets with the marinade, and let them sit for 10 minutes.
Line a baking sheet with baking paper.
Place the fish fillets on the baking sheet, and drizzle with vegetable oil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Remove the fish from the oven, and let it rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
